title: Gospel Presenter
tagline: Elegant, easy-to-use presentation tool for churches. Free and open source.
feature_presentations_desc: Build presentations with songs, Bible passages, images, video, audio and slideshows as PDF, exported from PowerPoint or Keynote. Save reusable templates and create new presentations in seconds.
feature_liveDisplay_desc: Show your presentation fullscreen on a connected screen or projector. Connect additional devices with a pairing code. Changes sync instantly to all connected displays.
feature_remoteControl_desc: Control the presentation from your phone or tablet when the presenter allows it.
feature_songLibrary_desc: Manage your church's song collection with lyrics, custom arrangements, and version history. Import songs from ProPresenter.
feature_bible_desc: Browse and search multiple Bible translations. Add verses directly into your presentations.
feature_overlays_desc: Display text or images on top of your slides — perfect for announcements, QR codes, or collection info.
feature_songTracking_desc: Automatically track which songs are shown during each service — making it easy to compile CCLI reports.
feature_stageMode_desc: Worship leaders and musicians follow the presentation on their phone or tablet: the slide on screen, the next one and the whole list.
feature_offline_desc: Keep presentations on your computer ahead of time, so they can be shown even if the network goes down. Changes made offline sync once it is back.
gettingStarted1: Gospel Presenter is a free and open-source presentation tool built for churches. It makes it easy to display song lyrics and Bible verses on a second screen or projector during services.
gettingStarted2: We run Gospel Presenter at app.gospelpresenter.com for invited churches. Get in touch through GitHub. Running your own server will be possible later on.
gettingStarted3: Everything runs in the browser, on any computer, phone or tablet.
gettingStarted4: The project is open source — completely free to use and run.
faqIntro: Gospel Presenter is in an early stage of development — new features land continuously. The answers below describe what is in place today.
faq_q1: Is Gospel Presenter really completely free?
faq_a1: Yes. The project is open source and free to use. There are no license fees, subscriptions, or locked features.
faq_q2: How does Gospel Presenter differ from ProPresenter, EasyWorship, and others?
faq_a2: Gospel Presenter is made to be simple and elegant, with an interface that is polished and beautiful – not always what you get from an open-source app. You put a service together in minutes, and it looks good on the screen without settings to tune. It is lightweight, and it looks the same everywhere: on the computer, in the browser, on the phone and on the tablet. Whoever has used it in one place finds their way in all the others, and everything syncs seamlessly between them – a change on one device is on all of them a moment later. The musicians follow along on their own phones. And it is completely free and open source, with no licence per computer and no locked features. ProPresenter and EasyWorship have more specialist features, but most churches don't need them on an ordinary Sunday.
faq_q3: What do I need to run Gospel Presenter?
faq_a3: A modern browser and an invitation to our instance. Your own server through Docker comes later.
faq_q4: Do I need to install anything on the church computers?
faq_a4: No. Gospel Presenter runs entirely in the browser — neither the operator, projector, nor mobile device needs any app installed. All you need is a modern browser like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
faq_q5: Does it work on Mac, Windows, and Linux?
faq_a5: Yes. Because everything runs in the browser, the operating system doesn't matter.
faq_q6: Do I need an internet connection during the service?
faq_a6: Presentations you have kept offline can be shown on the computer and its projector with no network. Screens connected with a code, remote control and the audience view go through the server and need the network.
faq_q7: Can I import my songs from ProPresenter?
faq_a7: Yes. Gospel Presenter reads ProPresenter 7 (.pro) files and imports them into the song library.
faq_a8: The song title, author, publisher, and CCLI number are imported along with the song lyrics and the labels (verse/chorus/bridge) that exist in the file. Not included: themes, background images, fonts, stage notes, or other media — just text and metadata.
faq_a9: You upload the Bible translations you have the right to use. Search and insert verses directly into presentations. You can have multiple translations side by side and switch between them.
faq_q10: Can I show background images or background videos behind the song lyrics?
faq_a10: Yes. A theme sets the background behind song and Bible text: a colour or a picture, dimmed if you like. There are two built-in themes, and you can make your own. Video backgrounds are not there yet.
faq_q11: Can I show the presentation on multiple screens at the same time?
faq_a11: Yes. You can display the presentation on as many screens as you like — for example a projector plus a separate monitor on stage. Each additional screen opens in a browser and connects via a pairing code, or via a saved-display URL for devices that should always be used. Musicians can follow along on their phones.
faq_q12: Can I customize fonts, colors, and backgrounds?
faq_a12: Yes, in your church's own themes: font, size, colours and background.
faq_q13: Can multiple people control the presentation at the same time?
faq_a13: Yes, when the presenter allows remote control. An admin can also choose that it is always or never allowed.
faq_q14: Which languages does the interface support?
faq_a14: The interface is currently available in English and Swedish.
faq_a15: On our instance everything is stored with Cloudflare. Each device also keeps its own copy. We share data with no one.
faq_a16: Gospel Presenter is under active development. That means features are added continuously, things may change, and bugs may occur. Feel free to try the tool, but expect it to still be maturing. Feedback helps us prioritize.
faq_q17: How can I contribute or report bugs?
faq_a17: All development happens openly on GitHub. There you can report bugs, suggest features, or contribute code. Pull requests and feedback are welcome.
downloadIntro: The desktop app is in beta, for macOS, Windows and Linux. Sign in with your account, with Google or a passkey, and what you have on the web is here too, shown on the church's screens. If you would rather manage without the internet and without our server, the computer can instead become the church's own host, which phones and screens connect to on your own network. The app does not update itself yet, so come back here for new versions.
downloadUnknownVersion: Open the releases page to download the latest version
downloadNoBuildForPlatform: This release has no build for your computer. Use Gospel Presenter in your browser in the meantime.
downloadOtherPlatform: The desktop app is for computers. On a phone or tablet, use Gospel Presenter in your browser.
downloadUnsignedTitle: First start needs one extra step
downloadUnsignedMac: The app is not yet signed with an Apple certificate, so macOS blocks it the first time. Open the downloaded file. If macOS refuses, go to System Settings, then Privacy & Security, scroll down and choose Open Anyway. You only do this once.
downloadUnsignedWindows: The app is not yet signed, so Windows warns the first time. Choose More info, then Run anyway. You only do this once.
